metadata.description: Partial checklist for remaining properties not covered in Stage 1 boundaries

checklist.title: Verify Prague system calls are triggered only after all user transactions complete
detection_procedure: 1. Locate block processing logic in core/state_processor.go Process()
2. Find the ProcessBeaconBlockRoot, ProcessParentBeaconBlockRoot, and system contract calls
3. Verify that all user transactions from block.Transactions() are processed first
4. Check that EIP-6110 (deposits), EIP-7002 (withdrawals), EIP-7251 (consolidations) system calls execute after user transactions
5. Verify the ordering: user txs -> system contract calls -> finalization
6. Check ApplyBeaconBlockRoot and related functions are called at correct position
7. Trace requests processing in core/blockchain.go insertChain to confirm ordering

executable_checks.assertion: Request parsing functions for Prague EIPs exist

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BP-EDGE-BP-REQUESTS-001 -> Edge EDGE-BP-REQUESTS. Prague+ only. Ordering ensures user transactions see consistent state before system calls modify it.

checklist.title: Verify block finalization occurs after all system calls complete
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Finalize function in consensus/beacon/consensus.go
2. Trace the call path from state_processor.go to consensus engine finalization
3. Verify that system contract calls (EIP-6110, EIP-7002, EIP-7251, EIP-2935, EIP-4788) complete before Finalize is called
4. Check that Finalize applies any final state mutations (e.g., rewards, if applicable)
5. Verify state root is computed only after Finalize completes
6. Confirm no state mutations occur between Finalize and state root computation
7. Check for any post-finalization processing that could invalidate the state root

executable_checks.assertion: Finalize function exists in beacon consensus
Finalize is called from state processor

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BP-EDGE-BP-FINALIZE-001 -> Edge EDGE-BP-FINALIZE. System calls precede finalization to ensure their state changes are included. Final state mutations before root computation.

checklist.title: Verify DATA-PROCESS-RESULT contains complete receipts, requests, and gas accounting
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the return type/structure of state_processor.go Process() function
2. Verify receipts array includes all transaction receipts in order
3. Check that logs are correctly aggregated from all receipts
4. Verify cumulative gas used matches sum of individual transaction gas
5. For Prague+: verify requests array includes deposit, withdrawal, and consolidation requests
6. Check that blob gas accounting (if applicable) is correctly included
7. Verify the result struct is used correctly by blockchain.go for validation

executable_checks.assertion: Process result structure with receipts and requests exists

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-BP-EDGE-BP-COMPLETE-001 -> Edge EDGE-BP-COMPLETE. Result aggregates all receipts, logs, and gas from processing. Return point to main graph for state root verification.

checklist.title: Verify transaction is properly converted to Message format before state transition begins
detection_procedure: 1. Locate TransitionDb or ApplyMessage in core/state_transition.go
2. Trace the conversion from Transaction to Message (TransactionToMessage or AsMessage)
3. Verify sender address is recovered from signature before state transition
4. Check that gas price, gas limit, nonce, value, data are all extracted correctly
5. Verify access list is converted for EIP-2930+ transactions
6. For EIP-4844: verify blob hashes are extracted
7. For EIP-7702: verify authorization list is converted
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-STATE-ST-START-001 -> State STATE-ST-START. Entry point for individual transaction execution. Transaction has been converted to Message format.

checklist.title: Verify secp256k1 signature verification prevents invalid signatures from proceeding
detection_procedure: 1. Locate signature verification in core/types/transaction_signing.go Sender() or RecoverPlain()
2. Trace the path to crypto.Ecrecover or crypto.SigToPub
3. Verify R, S values are checked to be within valid range (< secp256k1 order)
4. Check V value is validated for the transaction type
5. Verify signature malleability is prevented (S value check)
6. Confirm invalid signatures return error, not a wrong address
7. Check that recovered sender address is cached to prevent re-verification
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-VERIFY-SIGNATURE-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-VERIFY-SIGNATURE. Cryptographic guarantee: secp256k1 ECDSA signature verification. Sender address derived from signature recovery.

checklist.title: Verify nonce check prevents replay attacks and ensures transaction ordering
detection_procedure: 1. Locate nonce validation in core/state_transition.go preCheck() or similar
2. Verify sender's state nonce is compared against transaction nonce
3. Check that nonce mismatch returns ErrNonceTooLow or ErrNonceTooHigh
4. Verify nonce check occurs before any state modifications
5. Confirm nonce must exactly match current account nonce (no gaps allowed in execution)
6. Check for any code paths that might bypass nonce validation
7. Verify nonce validation behavior for EIP-7702 delegated accounts
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-CHECK-NONCE-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-CHECK-NONCE. Nonce prevents replay attacks and enforces transaction ordering.

checklist.title: Verify intrinsic gas calculation includes all required components
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IntrinsicGas function in core/state_transition.go
2. Verify base cost of 21000 gas is always included
3. Check data cost calculation: 4 gas for zero bytes, 16 gas for non-zero bytes
4. Verify access list cost: 2400 per address, 1900 per storage key
5. For contract creation: verify additional 32000 gas (CREATE_DATA_GAS)
6. For EIP-3860: verify initcode word cost (2 gas per 32-byte word)
7. For EIP-7702: verify authorization list processing cost
8. Check for integer overflow in gas calculation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-COMPUTE-INTRINSIC-GAS-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-COMPUTE-INTRINSIC-GAS. Base cost 21000 + data costs + access list costs + creation cost if applicable.

checklist.title: Verify transaction gas limit check against intrinsic gas prevents underpriced transactions
detection_procedure: 1. Locate gas limit check in core/state_transition.go preCheck() or TransitionDb()
2. Verify intrinsic gas is computed before comparison
3. Check that tx.GasLimit >= intrinsicGas is enforced
4. Verify failure returns ErrIntrinsicGas or similar
5. Confirm check occurs before any gas deduction
6. Check that block gas limit is also validated
7. Verify the check handles all transaction types correctly
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-CHECK-GAS-LIMIT-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-CHECK-GAS-LIMIT. Prevents impossible-to-execute transactions.

checklist.title: Verify balance sufficiency check prevents overdraft
detection_procedure: 1. Locate balance check in core/state_transition.go buyGas() or preCheck()
2. Verify cost calculation: gasLimit * gasPrice + value
3. For EIP-1559: verify gasLimit * maxFeePerGas + value
4. For EIP-4844: verify blob gas cost is added (maxFeePerBlobGas * blobGasUsed)
5. Verify balance check uses big.Int to prevent overflow
6. Check that SubBalance is only called after successful verification
7. Verify ErrInsufficientFunds is returned on failure

executable_checks.assertion: Balance checking and buyGas logic exists

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-CHECK-BALANCE-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-CHECK-BALANCE. Balance >= gas * gasPrice + value + blobGas. Prevents negative balance creation.

checklist.title: Verify gas pre-payment is atomically deducted before execution
detection_procedure: 1. Locate SubBalance call in core/state_transition.go buyGas()
2. Verify deduction amount = gasLimit * effectiveGasPrice
3. For EIP-4844: verify blob fee is also deducted
4. Check that deduction is atomic (no partial deduction)
5. Verify deduction occurs before nonce increment
6. Confirm state snapshot is taken before deduction for potential revert
7. Verify no execution proceeds without successful gas deduction
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-DEDUCT-GAS-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-DEDUCT-GAS. Pre-payment prevents mid-execution balance issues. Amount = gasLimit * effectiveGasPrice. Unused gas refunded after execution.

checklist.title: Verify nonce is incremented before execution and persists on revert
detection_procedure: 1. Locate SetNonce call in core/state_transition.go
2. Verify nonce increment: state.SetNonce(sender, nonce+1)
3. Check that increment occurs after gas deduction, before EVM execution
4. Verify nonce increment is NOT reverted on execution failure
5. Confirm nonce is part of journaled state but excluded from revert
6. Check for any code paths that might skip nonce increment
7. For EIP-7702: verify delegated account nonce handling
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-INCREMENT-NONCE-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-INCREMENT-NONCE. Nonce increment is permanent regardless of execution outcome.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-2930 access list is processed to warm addresses and storage slots
detection_procedure: 1. Locate access list processing in core/state_transition.go or core/state/access_list.go
2. Verify sender and recipient are added to warm addresses
3. Check that precompile addresses are warmed according to EIP-2929
4. Verify access list entries are processed: AddAddressToAccessList, AddSlotToAccessList
5. Check gas charging for access list entries (2400 per address, 1900 per slot)
6. Verify processing occurs before EVM execution
7. Confirm access list state is properly journaled for potential revert
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-PROCESS-ACCESS-LIST-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-PROCESS-ACCESS-LIST. EIP-2930 introduced optional access lists. Reduces gas cost for pre-declared accesses.

checklist.title: Verify EIP-7702 authorization processing validates signatures and applies code delegation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate EIP-7702 authorization processing (likely in core/state_transition.go or dedicated file)
2. Verify each authorization signature is validated using secp256k1
3. Check chain ID in authorization matches current chain
4. Verify nonce in authorization matches account nonce (or zero for fresh delegation)
5. Check that authority address is recovered correctly from signature
6. Verify code delegation is applied: account.code = delegatee code prefix + address
7. Confirm invalid authorizations are skipped, not causing transaction failure
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-PROCESS-SETCODE-AUTHS-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-PROCESS-SETCODE-AUTHS. Prague+ (EIP-7702). Enables EOA code delegation. Cryptographic guarantee: secp256k1 signature verification for each authorization.

checklist.title: Verify all pre-execution setup is complete before EVM execution begins
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the point in core/state_transition.go where EVM.Call or EVM.Create is invoked
2. Verify gas has been deducted (buyGas completed)
3. Verify nonce has been incremented (SetNonce called)
4. Verify access list has been processed (PrepareAccessList called)
5. For EIP-7702: verify authorizations have been processed
6. Check that state snapshot is taken for potential revert
7. Verify branch logic: To == nil triggers Create, To != nil triggers Call

executable_checks.assertion: Create vs Call branch logic exists

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-STATE-ST-PRE-EXECUTION-001 -> State STATE-ST-PRE-EXECUTION. Only reachable after all validation and setup steps complete successfully. Branch point: creation (To==nil) or call (To!=nil).

checklist.title: Verify evm.Create() executes initcode safely with proper gas limits and sandboxing
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Create and Create2 in core/vm/evm.go
2. Verify call depth check (< 1024) before execution
3. Verify EIP-3860 initcode size limit enforcement (49152 bytes max)
4. Check initcode gas cost calculation (2 gas per 32-byte word)
5. Verify contract address is computed correctly (CREATE vs CREATE2)
6. Check that created code is validated (no 0xEF prefix for legacy)
7. Verify code size limit (24576 bytes max) and deployment gas (200/byte)
8. Confirm execution is contained within EVM sandbox
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-EXECUTE-CREATE-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-EXECUTE-CREATE. Delegates to GRAPH-EVM-EXECUTION. Contract address computed deterministically.

checklist.title: Verify evm.Call() executes contract code safely with proper isolation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Call in core/vm/evm.go
2. Verify call depth check (< 1024) before execution
3. Check value transfer to recipient before code execution
4. Verify code lookup uses correct address (account code or EIP-7702 delegation)
5. Check precompile detection and handling
6. Verify gas is properly propagated to nested calls (63/64 rule)
7. Confirm memory, stack, and storage isolation between call frames
8. Verify return data is copied, not referenced
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-EXECUTE-CALL-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-EXECUTE-CALL. Delegates to GRAPH-EVM-EXECUTION. Reentrancy controlled by gas and call depth.

checklist.title: Verify execution result accurately reflects EVM outcome
detection_procedure: 1. Locate return path from EVM.Call/EVM.Create in core/state_transition.go
2. Verify ret (return data) is captured correctly
3. Check that vmerr (execution error) is propagated
4. Verify usedGas is correctly computed from initial gas minus remaining
5. Check that EVM errors (revert, out of gas, etc.) are handled distinctly
6. Verify execution success/failure determines receipt status correctly
7. Confirm state changes are rolled back on execution error (except for nonce/gas)
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-STATE-ST-EXECUTION-COMPLETE-001 -> State STATE-ST-EXECUTION-COMPLETE. Reached via completion edges from EVM execution. Result accurately captures outcome.

checklist.title: Verify gas refund is correctly capped at 20% per EIP-3529
detection_procedure: 1. Locate refund calculation in core/state_transition.go refundGas()
2. Verify refund is capped: refund = min(refund, gasUsed / 5)
3. Check that EIP-3529 cap (20%) is applied correctly
4. Verify SSTORE refund contributions are accumulated correctly
5. Check that SELFDESTRUCT refund was removed (EIP-3529)
6. Verify refund counter is reset per transaction
7. Confirm refund is added to remaining gas for return calculation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-CALCULATE-REFUND-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-CALCULATE-REFUND. EIP-3529 reduced max refund from 50% to 20% of gas used. Prevents refund exploitation attacks.

checklist.title: Verify unused gas is correctly refunded to sender
detection_procedure: 1. Locate AddBalance for sender in core/state_transition.go refundGas()
2. Verify refund amount = (gasLimit - gasUsed + cappedRefund) * effectiveGasPrice
3. Check that remaining gas is correctly computed
4. Verify refund uses the same gas price as initial deduction
5. Confirm AddBalance is called atomically
6. Check for integer overflow in refund calculation
7. Verify refund is correctly applied even on execution revert
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-REFUND-SENDER-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-REFUND-SENDER. Refund = (gasLimit - gasUsed + min(refund, gasUsed/5)) * effectiveGasPrice.

checklist.title: Verify coinbase receives only priority fee, not base fee (EIP-1559)
detection_procedure: 1. Locate coinbase payment in core/state_transition.go (after refundGas)
2. Verify payment amount = gasUsed * (effectiveGasPrice - baseFee)
3. For legacy transactions: verify full gas price goes to coinbase (pre-EIP-1559 logic)
4. For EIP-1559+: verify base fee is NOT added to coinbase balance (implicit burn)
5. Check AddBalance call for coinbase address
6. Verify calculation uses correct baseFee from block header
7. Confirm no overflow in fee calculation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-PAY-COINBASE-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-PAY-COINBASE. EIP-1559: base fee burned, only priority fee to coinbase. Payment = gasUsed * (effectiveGasPrice - baseFee).
